events.title: Jackknifed tanker

illustration.caption: A fuel tanker across both lanes

events.setup: A fuel tanker lies across both lanes, its cab folded into the guardrail. Nobody's touched it; the dust on the tank is unbroken.
events.situation: The tank still sloshes when the wind leans on it. The valve's rusted shut, and siphoning through the hatch takes hours.

outcomes.text: You run hose through the hatch and fill every can you brought. It takes most of the morning.

choices.title: Crack the valve clean
choices.preview: Someone who knows valves could drain it fast.

outcomes.text: Ten minutes with a pipe wrench and penetrating oil, and the valve gives. The tank drains into your cans like it was waiting to.

choices.title: Strip the cab
choices.preview: Good metal in it, if the tank stays put.

outcomes.text: You cut the doors, the bumper, and the seat frames free and stack them in the back.
The tank shifts as you pry at the cab and rolls into your lead vehicle. You get some metal, and a dented hood.
You ease past the tanker on the gravel and leave it to the next convoy.

events.title: Burned-out school bus

illustration.caption: A school bus on its rims

events.setup: A school bus sits on its rims in the middle of the road, every window black with old smoke. The luggage racks look full.
events.situation: Fresh tire tracks circle it twice and head off into the scrub. Someone wants you to stop here.

choices.title: Search the bus
choices.preview: Quick, and maybe exactly what they want.

outcomes.text: Whoever left the tracks is long gone. The racks hold a med kit and a bag of bolts.
Engines start up in the scrub before you're through the door. It was bait.

fight.text: With the raiders gone, you strip their buggies along with the bus.

choices.title: Follow the tracks
choices.preview: Find where they're waiting before they find you.

outcomes.text: The tracks end at a camouflaged dugout, empty. Their stash is still in it.
You go round the bus wide and don't slow down. Nothing follows.

events.title: Overturned armored car

illustration.caption: An armored car on its roof in the ditch

events.setup: An armored car lies on its roof in the ditch, wheels in the air. The rear doors are dented but shut.
events.situation: It's built to keep people out. It might also be built well enough to run again.

choices.title: Pry the doors
choices.preview: Whatever it was carrying is still inside.

outcomes.text: The doors give after an hour on the bar. Inside: spare plating, still in its crate.

choices.title: Get it running
choices.preview: Right it, patch it, and it rides with you.

outcomes.text: You winch it upright, swap the fouled plugs, and patch the fuel line. It coughs, then idles. It's riding with you now.
You leave it on its roof. Somebody else can have the doors.

events.title: Family under fire

illustration.caption: A family car on its side, buggies circling

events.setup: Your convoy crests a ridge to find a family's car on its side below, smoke pouring from the engine.
events.situation: Three raider buggies circle the wreck, firing into the air. The family huddles behind the car. You have moments to decide.

outcomes.text: You come down the ridge at full throttle. The buggies break off the circle and turn on you.

fight.text: The last buggy runs. The family climbs out from behind the car and asks to ride with you.

choices.title: Kill their engines
choices.preview: Stop all three buggies at once.

outcomes.text: The pulse kills every engine in the hollow. The raiders run for it on foot, and the family rides out with you.

choices.title: Pay them off
choices.preview: Fuel's worth more to them than a family.

outcomes.text: They take the cans and go. The family rides out with you.
They take the cans, then take a few shots at you on the way out. The family rides out with you anyway.
You drop back behind the ridge. The shots fade behind you.

events.title: Mayday on channel nine

illustration.caption: A rig nose-down in a ditch

events.setup: The radio crackles with a voice a mile ahead: a driver, her rig nose-down in a ditch, her leg pinned under the dash.
events.situation: She says the road gang that ran her off is still about. She can drive, if somebody gets her out.

choices.title: Pull her out
choices.preview: Cut her free and hope the gang stays away.

outcomes.text: You cut the dash away and lift her out. She's hurt, but she can drive, and she'd rather drive for you.
The gang hears the saw and comes back for her.

fight.text: Once the gang's gone, you lift her out of the cab. She'd rather drive for you than wait for the next one.

choices.title: Treat her on the spot
choices.preview: The med truck can do more than a saw.

outcomes.text: The med truck's crew frees her leg and splints it in the cab, then patches up your own while they're at it. She's driving for you now.
You switch the radio off and take the next turn.
